projectDescription: Terriqon is an offline-first field reporting SaaS platform that collects structured data from field teams and uses AI to generate verified, funder-ready reports in minutes.
keyFeatures: Offline-first mobile data collection (PWA, works in zero-signal zones)
AI-generated reports (Project, Ops, Donor, Portfolio types)
Automated PII stripping before any AI processing
Human approval workflow — no report is shared without a manager sign-off
Real-time GPS and submission tracking on a live map
Role-based access control (Admin, Manager, Field Officer)
Data quality gating — low-confidence data is routed to human review
14-day free trial, no credit card required
publicApiSurface: Organization Admin role — full account, billing, and user management
Organization Manager role — project management, report review and approval
Field Officer role — form submissions via PWA (online or offline)
Form Builder — drag-and-drop interface with sensitivity field tagging
AI Reports — Project, Ops, Donor, Portfolio report types
Billing portal — plan upgrades, downgrades, seat management
Data Export — CSV, Excel, JSON via Platform or API
Enterprise/Command plan ($749/mo, 150 seats, unlimited AI reports)
